title: Dr. Talbot's family and Herb Morand's band
summary: Mistaken identity about a doctor brother; he names Herb Morand's band with Walter Nelson, Simon Frazier and a tenor player.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Is that the... Does he have a brother that's a doctor or something, Yalla? Is that the one? No. Was he a policeman or something?
No, you talking about Talbot. Talbot's got a brother that's a dentist.
Yeah, he's up there in Jackson Avenue if he's still there yet. Who's that?
Dr. Talbot. I wonder if Dr. Sherry was up there on.
No, not that I know of.

I think Dr. Sherry was down here somewhere on Claiborne Street. I see. It's funny, I can't remember who Yalla would be or whenever I asked you. Oh no, I think that was long before your time. Yeah. Yeah, that was long before your time. When you played with Herb Moran, who did you play with the band? Well, I was Herb, Walter Nelson.
And we had one of Lauren's other cousins. who played piano.
I can't remember his name either. It was long before your time. Yeah. It was long before your time.
When you played with Herb Moran, who did you say was in that band now?
My name was Herb, Walter Nelson, and we had one of Lawrence's other cousins that played piano. I can't recall his name either.
Oh, is he related to Saeed? Yeah.
I know who you mean. Simon. Simon Fraser. Yeah, Simon Fraser. And fellow saxist comes to me now, his name was Alfred. I never knew his full name. All I knew was Alfred.
Did he play tenor, alto, or baritone? Tenor. Tenor. Any other clarinet players besides George?
